title: Render Preset (Standardize Rendering)
content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍 Learn how to use [Render Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) feature to standardize the Rendering results within the team. * What is Render Preset? * Upload Render Preset in CLO-SET * Using Render Preset * Render Preset Properties created inCLO # **📓 Details** **• What is Render Preset?** --- * Render Preset helps **standardize** the Render Properties for a cohesive output generation ![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Butter.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778065909017)![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Velvet Pink.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778066040217)![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Grey.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778103367833)![CLO-SET_Default_2024.1.256_for Colorway Compatibility_Blue.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778082594841) * Render Preset allows users to apply **detailed****Render Properties** when Rendering in CLO-SET[ ](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) in CLO3D [![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778066869657)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) | ▶ | in CLO-SET [![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778103990937)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) ---|---|--- **• Upload Render Preset (.ZVRP) in CLO-SET** --- * From the left pane, click Browse > Company, then go to Settings > Rendering to Add/Edit/Delete Render Preset. * Click **Upload File** to add a Render Preset. * You can **Add / Edit / Delete** presets here. * Up to **32 preset files** can be uploaded. * [Please note: Company Settings are accessible to Company Admin only](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978742878105) | | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978742878873) ---|---|--- _**💡 Note – How to Create a Render Preset File (ZVRP) From CLO Software**_ > Before uploading to CLO-SET, you need to create a **ZVRP (Render Preset) file** from **CLO software.**
> > ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778083250457) | ► | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778083552153) > ---|---|--- > > * On CLO3D software, adjust Render properties per your needs on the Property Editor
> * Once you are done, click **Save As > Render Properties** to save as **ZVRP** file
> * The saved ZVRP includes Image/Video, Camera, Light, and Render properties
> * A few requirements for CLO-SET:
> * Image count for Turntable must be less than 64
> * Image size must be less than 5,000px
> * Animation type can not be rendered
> * *Please note: If you select the 'Current View' option from CLO3D, CLO-SET Render will be based on the last view each user sees on their CLO-SET 3D Viewer. is used to design and create garments in 3D, while **CONNECT** is the marketplace for buying and selling avatars, garments, and digital assets. > **CLO-SET** then brings these assets together into a collaborative workspace for managing, reviewing, sharing, and seamlessly carrying them through merchandising and production.
> **• Using Render Preset** --- * From your Dashboard, click the Content to open the Content page, where you can view the 3D Viewer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978742879769) * Select the options as per needed, and **click 'Render'** to create Render (_Learn more about_[ _Render Settings_](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207203225)) > _**Render on the Content Page**_
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495264357657)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495264358681)
> > * In **New** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495249963161)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495249964057)
> > * On your Content Page, click on Render to select the Render Settings. * On the drop-down menu, you will see the **Company Preset** (with ![company.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778084170905) icon) > _**Select Render Preset on the Content Page**_
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978753788057)
> > * In **New** **Content** Page
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495249965081)
> > _**💡 Note**_ > Once you select the Company's Render Preset option, you can not change the Render Settings. You may check the Property details by clicking on the 𝒊 icon of the preset.
> > ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54978753789337) | ► | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778103990937) > ---|---|--- **•**[**Render Preset Properties created in CLO**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) --- * #### To view the full list of properties saved in a ZVRP file from CLO, please visit [**Render Preset Guide**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) [![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778119339929)](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129)
content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide to using the Render Preset feature in CLO-SET, enabling teams to standardize rendering results for consistent and cohesive outputs.

title: Comment
content:
# **Objective** Share your feedback with the team with CLO-SET Comment feature. 1. Creating Comment * Attach Images in Comment * AI Translator in Comments 2. Search Comment 3. Workroom & Assortment Comment 4. Web Tech Pack Comment 5. Permission 6. Notification # **Details** ### 1) Creating Comment **1\. Create Comment:** click ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778356271257) icon from top-right corner, and start creating comments. You can tag individual user or [Teams](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303212732441) by using @ (ex. @clovirtualfashion). Maximum length is 3000 letters. *Please note that mentioning a non-member will automatically grant can View access. **2\. Create Editor:** You can edit the color, font, background color, or add emojis and attachments on the comment. Supported formats for attachments are: png, jpg, jpeg, pjpeg, gif, bmp. You may attach up to 25 files per Comment. Shortcut keys available on Edit Mode: * **Bold** : Ctrl (Cmd) + B * _Italic_ : Ctrl (Cmd) + I * Underline: Ctrl (Cmd) + U * @Mention: @ + name * Emoji 😊: [Window + . ] OR [Ctrl+Cmd+Space Bar] * In addition, bullet & numbering is also available as below. To add a bullet, add an asterisk (*) and hit space **3\. View All**[**Versions**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961)**:** By default, you will comments on all Versions. Uncheck to only view the comments created on current Version. > _**Comment on the Content Page**_
> > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page > > ![Screenshot 2023-11-08 at 5.44.26 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778356072985) > > > * In **Legacy** **Content** Page
> > The Comment feature has been expanded to the content level, allowing comments to be added while reviewing different tabs.
> > An activity log is also available for review. > (_Note: The activity log is only accessible to users with Editor-level permissions or higher._)
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/56495567360793)
> > * ### Attach Images to your Comment (updated Feb 2024) 1. Drag & Drop Images from your local drive. 2. Preview Images before posting. 3. Availability to post Images only (without a text). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778347736217) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778347989657) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334192793) ---|---|--- * ### AI Translator in Comments CLO-SET now supports **AI-powered translation** in comments to improve cross-language collaboration. * Available in both **Space Comments** and **Content Comments** * Click **Translate** on a comment to view it in your preferred language This feature helps teams communicate more effectively across regions and languages without leaving the platform. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393488326425) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393488328985) ### 2) Search Comment * Search the comment you're looking for. Type in the keyword, and hit enter to view the results at the bottom. ![Screenshot 2023-11-08 at 5.55.22 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334395033) ### 3) Workroom & Assortment Comment * Commenting is also available at the [Workroom](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) and [Assortment](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168765593) level. * Please see below for details on Permissions (create, edit, and delete) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334541081) ### 4) Web Tech Pack Comment * Commenting is also available on all [Web Tech Pack](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) tabs. * Comments are created/saved separate on each Tab (Overview, BOM, Construction, Measurement, and Cost Estimation). * Under each Comment, you can find the version information of the uploaded file. * Please see below for details on Permissions (create, edit, and delete) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334743065) ### 5) Permission **Space** | **Action** | **Admin & Collaborator** | **Editor** | **Viewer** ---|---|---|---|--- **All** | **Create** | O | O | O **Workroom** **WTP** **Content** | **Edit** | * Group, Company Admin: O * Brand Admin, Collaborator: Limited* | Limited* **Delete** **Assortment** | **Edit** | * Admin: O * Collaborator: Limited* **Delete** **All** | **Mention others** | O | O | X *Can only Edit/Delete comments created by oneself, cannot modify comments created by other users. **Permission varies on Space Level. To start using Comment features, user must have permission to the applicable Space/Content. For example, if a user holds Content Editor permission, they can create new Comment on that Content, but may not be able to create Workroom Content. ### 6) Notification * When a Comment is created/edited/deleted, notification will be sent to the users with permission to the Workroom/Assortment/Content. * To stop receiving notifications, end users can turn off notification settings on specific Space or Content by unchecking the 'bell' button. * Notification of new Comments will be displayed on the Notifications tab. * Email Notification may be sent based on the end user's notification settings on 'My Page'. \- Depending on the notification settings, user can either receive all notifications or only those that are relevant. 1. 1. **All Comments** \- Continue to receive notifications for all comments. 2. **Mentioned Comments and Replies to My Comments Only** \- Receive notifications when mentioned \- Receive notifications when someone replies to the comment writer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334892825) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778370438809) ---|--- > 💡 **Note:** The **"Changes on Comment"** notification options can be configured on the **My Page**. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54775456945689)
content_description: The CLO-SET Comment feature empowers teams to collaborate effectively by sharing feedback, attaching images, utilizing AI translation, and managing comments across various project spaces.

title: Intro: Web Tech Pack
content:
# **📝 List of Contents** 📍 Start communicating real-time on the auto-generated Web Tech Pack. * Opening a content page * Web Tech Pack - Tabs * Share & Export # **📓 Details** **![web tech pack.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777931380121)**| CLO-SET [Web Tech Pack](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) integrates your everyday tech pack with 3D Contents. Let us bring all the data from your 3D file into an auto-generated Tech Pack. Enjoy a tech pack that is always up-to-date. ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777946851737) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777916704409) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777956966425) ---|---|--- **• Opening (.zprj / .zpac) File in the Content Page** --- * Enter [Dashboard](https://www.style.clo-set.com), and click the Content to open the Content page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54979411347097) * Enter the Content Page, and click Web Tech Pack icon ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54979397582233) * A new tab will open. Switch between tabs to review & edit. Find more on the following guide![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777932283161) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54979411347993) **• Web Tech Pack - Tabs** --- ***Important** : Web Tech Pack is created per [Content Version](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961) (zprj/zpac only), and selecting 'update' will create a new version of Web Tech Pack. You can switch between versions on the WTP page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777968186265) ### ▶ Web TechPack Overview ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777948218905) * Overview tab provides basic information of the uploaded file. Find content information summary and mark the schedule to keep everyone on the same page * Information is auto-filled based on [Content Information](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185603609) ### ▶ BOM ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777968577177) * **BOM** is auto-filled based on the 3D data of the .zprj/.zpac file * Double-click the field to make edits. Information is managed per Colorway-Grade combination * Add Trim information by clicking 'add' at the bottom of the page * Click the 'Export' button on the top right corner to download an Excel file ### ▶ Construction ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777948699801) * Review the construction of the design, and create [Annotations](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191080217) for feedback * For each page, automatic markers will be generated. title: Copy Space Structure
content: #### **Permission** : may vary per scenario. Please see below. # **Objective** With this feature, you can easily replicate the Space Structure to prepare for a new season. 1. Copy Space Structure 2. Copy Company 3. Copy Brand 4. Copy Line/Season 5. Additional Notes # **Details** ### 1) Copy Space Structure * Simply copy any Space from Company to Season along with sub-level Spaces up to the 1st-depth Workroom. * Only the Space Hierarchy will be copied, **NOT** including the Contents within the original Space. ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.09.29 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778491077529) * **Basics:** * Go to 'Browse' menu or 'Workspace' to find the Space you want to Copy * On the upper-right corner of the Space, click ••• then click 'Copy Space Structure' * Insert the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' * **Only the Space Structure will be copied** without Contents, Categories, and Workflows ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.28.31 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778475909017) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55008522309145) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778476467737) ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.28.41 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492075033) ### 2) Copy Company Structure **Permission** : Group Admin only * Go to Workspace > Companies to select the Company to Copy * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Company > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Space, and click 'Confirm' * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Company Space. * You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu * The new Company Space will replicate all Company Settings of the original Company. ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.42.51 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778477146521) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 6.25.09 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778476219673) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.45.52 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492822681) ---|---|--- ### 3) Copy Brand Structure **Permission** : Group Admin, Company Admin * Option 1: Go to 'Browse' > and select the Company within which the Brand is located * Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' > Brands * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Brand > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Brand, and select where you want the new Brand to be * You may only choose between Company Spaces you have permission to * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. You will be redirected to the new Brand Space. * You can also find the new Space on the 'Browse' menu ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.55.03 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778492992537) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.52.03 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778478042521) | ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.53.44 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778493487513) ---|---|--- ![Screenshot 2023-12-04 at 7.55.24 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778493748505) ### ### 4) Copy Line/Season Structure **Permission** : Group Admin, Company Admin, Company Collaborator, Brand Admin * Option 1: Go to 'Browse' > and select the Brand within which the Line/Season is located * Option 2: Go to 'Workspace' > Lines/Seasons * Click on ••• on the upper-right corner of the Line/Season > click 'Copy Space Structure' * Type in the name of the new Space, and select where you want the new Line/Season to be * You may only choose between Brand Spaces you have permission to * Once complete, click on 'Go to the Space'. title: Strain Map on 3D Viewer
content: Compatible with Contents uploaded post **December 6th, 2023** # **Objectives** With this update, you can view the garment Strain map as done in CLO3D. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55009655280281) 1. Strain Map in Content Page * Compatibility 2. What is Strain Map? # **Details** ### 1) Strain Map in Content Page In the Content Page, click the 'Strain Map' icon, or use shortcut key (Shift + 7) Once Strain Map is activated, you can find the Tightness Range bar on the top right. #### **[Strain Map Compatibility]** * Content must have been uploaded after **December 6th, 2023**. If you see below error message, please re-upload the file to view Strain Map. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778307250457) * Strain Map is only applied to garments, not avatars. * Strain Map is **NOT** compatible with: * Garment Rendering Style Group * Schematic Render * Render * Configurator * Filter ### 2) What is Strain Map? ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778307394329) Strain Map displays the distortion rate from 2D patterns to 3D patterns. This view is the same as CLO3D's ['Strain Map'](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/articles/115012227287-Strain-Map) view in 'Monochrome' mode. * (3D pattern size / 2D Pattern size * 100)% Blue: 100% distortion, which means no distortion keeping the original pattern stretch Red: 120% distortion. The higher the rate is, the more distortion there are between 2D & 3D patterns. You may adjust the pattern placement/size based on the Strain Map data.
content_description: Discover how to utilize the Strain Map feature for garments uploaded after December 6th, 2023, to analyze distortion rates between 2D and 3D patterns in CLO3D.
